span: One of the intriguing problems in the paradigm of adaptive nonparametric function estimation as developed in the last two decades is what one could call the “hiatus” between estimation and inference, or, to be more precise, between the existence of adaptive risk bounds and the nonexistence of adaptive confidence statements.
